roadmap_gap_summary.roadmap_phase_goal: first loadable Zigux runtime modules with selftest hooks and runtime module lifecycle parity
roadmap_gap_summary.missing_capability: shared runtime substrate that can turn the bounded bitmap loader scaffold into a real loadable module path
roadmap_gap_summary.blocked_deliverable: loadable Phase 9 runtime bitmap pilot module parity
roadmap_gap_summary.next_gate: keep the loader scaffold, top-bit companion contract, and shared-request lifecycle proof explicit until the shared runtime loader substrate can consume the handoff plan

gaps.why_now: A bounded loader scaffold keeps the entry and exit symbol names, focused lifecycle counters, and release-without-substrate handoff reviewable without implying live runtime registration parity.
The roadmap's loadable runtime bitmap lifecycle parity still depend on shared runtime substrate pieces before any honest claim of live bitmap module binding.
